3D VIEWPORT CONTROLS:
• Terrain Sculpt Mode: Left-Click ground for 3-Axis Arrows; Right-Click drag to orbit camera
• Trench Maker Mode: Hold Right-Click & Drag across terrain to draw a line; release to carve trench (Left/Middle drag orbits)
• Select & Delete Any Object: Click any object to select it and press Backspace or Delete to remove it
• Tree & Brush Box: Hold Left-Click & Drag inside a box to move it; click ground outside existing boxes to place another
• 3D Tunnels Maze: Places in air initially; drag Up Arrow / Side Arrow at end to curve 3D; press Up / Down Arrow Keys to move assembly vertically
• 3-Axis Rotation Rings: Drag Red (X-Pitch), Green (Y-Yaw), or Blue (Z-Roll) rings or use sliders
▲/◯ RED (X): East-West / Pitch ▲/◯ GREEN (Y): Elevation / Yaw ▲/◯ BLUE (Z): North-South / Roll
